svg.title: Prakhar Gupta — Backend & security tooling
svg.desc: Backend & security tooling in TypeScript and Python. 13 merged pull requests in OWASP cve-lite-cli. 1,835 contributions in the last year. OPEN TO SWE INTERNSHIPS · ANY TERM.
